Historically, the name may have been given to a child in recognition of the mother's queenly status or as a symbol of hope for a future Queen. It is also a popular name in the Italian culture, and it is associated with elegance, grace, and beauty.

The name Reginella serves as a constant reminder of the importance of Mary's role in Christian theology and the hope and faith that she inspires.
